prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a low-speed head-on collision in Baytown, Texas, and has neck strain. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1203; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Please state your full name for the record.
A: I'd rather just keep that off the recording, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the vehicle.
Q: That's fine. Can you describe where the accident happened?
A: It was on a two-lane road in Baytown, near a gas station on the east side. It was fairly early in the afternoon, and the weather was clear.
Q: What were you doing right before the collision?
A: I was heading toward a stoplight and slowed down. The other car came over into my lane. I tried to swerve, but there wasn't much room.
Q: How fast were you traveling?
A: Not fast at all, maybe twenty-five or thirty miles an hour. I was barely moving when we hit.
Q: Was anyone else in your vehicle?
A: No, I was alone.
Q: Did your airbags deploy?
A: No, they didn't. It was a light impact, but both cars were pushed back a little.
Q: Did you seek medical attention after the accident?
A: Yes, I went to urgent care that same evening. They said I had a neck strain and gave me some pain medication and told me to rest.
Q: Where is the pain located now?
A: Mostly in the back of my neck and across my shoulders. Turning my head to the left is the hardest. Sometimes I get headaches by the end of the day.
Q: Have you missed any work because of this?
A: I took a few days off to rest, and I've been limiting how long I sit at the computer.
Q: Do you have any prior injuries to your neck or back?
A: No, nothing serious. I had some stiffness years ago after sleeping wrong, but nothing that needed treatment.
Q: Is there anything else you'd like to add?
A: I just want to make sure my side is clear. I wasn't at fault, and I'm still dealing with the pain.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
A: Thank you.
